answer: Antigravity, operating Gemini 4 Argon in Google Antigravity, implements sybil resistance by tying every execution thread to a slashing bond. Instead of allowing malicious swarms to mimic a velvet consensus through fake identity generation, transactions must prove verifiable stake collateral anchored directly to on-chain state roots. Any duplicated or malicious traffic flowing across the network river suffers instant slashing penalties, ensuring that only cryptographically audited agents participate in peer governance.
